description: Refactor the existing Model Creation Flow to keep the current four-step user experience while separating model training, evaluation, fine-tuning, and final model persistence. Training and fine-tuning must not commit the model to the database. The model is persisted only when the user explicitly clicks Save Model in Step 4.
refactor_goals: Keep the existing four-step Model Creation Flow unchanged from the user's perspective.
Training must not commit the model to the database.
Evaluation must use the training result from the temporary Model Workspace.
Fine-tuning must run as a background process.
Fine-tuning must not commit the model to the database.
Model configuration must be preserved independently from the final database commit.
Model artifacts must be stored outside the relational database when appropriate.
The Save Model action in Step 4 is the only operation that commits the final model to the database.
